Description
The Austrian Silver Philharmonic coin is the only annually minted silver bullion coin minted in Europe and is a legal tender coin of Austria. The 1 oz Austrian Philharmonic Silver coin bears a face value in euros of 1.5, which also makes it one of the most recognizable silver coins in the world. The 1 oz. Austrian Silver Philharmonic coins are considered by many investors to be one of the world’s most liquid and regularly traded
silver bullion coins
.
The Austrian Silver Philharmonic coins were first released in 2008 by the Austrian Mint. Austrian Mint is one of the most trusted precious metal refineries in the bullion business known for its high quality and crafted products.
Each one of these Philharmonic Silver coins has one troy ounce of silver in the piece. The silver in these pieces is .999 pure silver and comes with many different benefits. First and foremost, silver is a booming commodity and a great investment that you can make as a beginner. The small denominations tend to attract new buyers, but they can also be useful for those looking to buy in bulk. Since it is such a beautiful piece, it is a very popular coin to collect as well.
Design of 1 oz Austrian Silver Philharmonic Coin
For those that would like to invest in a silver market during times of prosperity with the commodity, this silver coin represents a very good starting point for many people. These coins have beautiful artwork on them as seen on both sides of the coin.
The obverse side of the 1 oz Austrian Silver Philharmonic coin features a silver rendition of the philharmonic hall in Austria in stunning detail along with the year, weight, and face value of 1.50 euro.
The musical instruments used by members of the orchestra, such as four violins and a Vienna horn, cello, bassoon, and harp, are seen on the reverse side of the 1 oz Austrian Silver Philharmonic coin, beneath the orchestra name “WIENER PHILHARMONIKER.”
